## LendingClub Accepted Loans {#sec-data-lendingclub-kaggle}

LendingClub operated an online marketplace that matched individual borrowers with
investors who funded loans in small fractional shares ("notes"). To let investors screen
and price loans, the company published detailed loan-level records for every funded loan —
borrower credit attributes recorded at origination together with the loan's subsequent
repayment history. These data are widely used to study consumer-credit default and loan
pricing. This card documents a cleaned extract used to model loan **charge-off** and
investor **payoff**.

**Resources:**

- [Kaggle dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/wordsforthewise/lending-club)

**Provenance.** The underlying data were released by LendingClub Corporation (San Francisco,
CA) as public loan-performance files covering U.S. consumer loans issued 2007–2018 Q4, and
were compiled into a single Kaggle dataset by Nathan George (user *wordsforthewise*). This
extract uses only the **accepted/funded** loans and restricts to loans **issued 2008–2012**
that had reached a terminal status — `Fully Paid` or `Charged Off` (92,902 loans; 15.4%
charged off). It retains 45 analysis-relevant columns and adds a small number of derived
fields (below). Two files share this schema: `df_all.csv` (all purposes) and `df_subs.csv`,
which further restricts to three purposes (`debt_consolidation`, `home_improvement`,
`small_business`). Data are available at the Kaggle dataset page linked above; consult that
page for current license terms. See @lendingclub-kaggle for the primary citation.

### Variables {.unnumbered}

Columns are grouped by role. **Targets** are modeled outcomes; **payment record** fields
are realized after origination and are used only to construct the payoff targets (never as
predictors of default). Derived fields (created in the extract) are labeled and defined in
terms of their source columns.

| Variable | Type | Unit / Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fully_paid` | Binary | 0/1 | 1 = loan Fully Paid, 0 = Charged Off. Primary classification target (charge-off = 1 − `fully_paid`). |
| `loan_status` | Categorical | Fully Paid, Charged Off | Terminal loan outcome; source of `fully_paid`. |
| `payoff_net` | Derived (continuous) | USD, 0–62,080 | `total_pymnt − collection_recovery_fee`: dollars netted to the investor. Primary payoff-regression target. |
| `payoff_frac` | Derived (continuous) | fraction, 0–1.77 | `payoff_net / funded_amnt`: scale-free payoff (share of funded amount returned). |
| `payoff_gross` | Derived (continuous) | USD, 0–62,080 | `= total_pymnt`: gross dollars the borrower paid back (already includes recoveries). |
| `recovery_channel` | Categorical (derived) | collection / debt_sale / no_recovery | How a charged-off loan resolved, backed out from `recoveries` and `collection_recovery_fee`. `NA` for fully-paid loans. |
| `loan_amnt` | Continuous | USD, 500–35,000 | Amount the borrower requested/listed. |
| `funded_amnt` | Continuous | USD, 500–35,000 | Amount actually funded (≈ `loan_amnt`). |
| `funded_amnt_inv` | Continuous | USD, 0–35,000 | Portion of the loan funded by investors. |
| `term` | Binary | 36 or 60 months | Number of scheduled monthly payments. |
| `int_rate` | Continuous | %, 5.42–24.89 | Loan interest rate. |
| `installment` | Continuous | USD, 16–1,388 | Scheduled monthly payment. |
| `grade` | Ordinal | A–G | LendingClub-assigned risk grade (A best). |
| `sub_grade` | Ordinal | A1–G5 | Finer risk subgrade within `grade`. |
| `credit_score` | Derived (discrete) | 45–79 | `80 − rank(sub_grade)`: a continuous re-encoding of `sub_grade`. Kept for exposition only; not used as a model predictor (redundant with `grade`/`sub_grade`). |
| `purpose` | Categorical | 14 levels | Borrower-stated loan purpose (e.g., `debt_consolidation`). |
| `title` | Categorical (text) | — | Borrower-supplied loan title (free text, high-cardinality). |
| `issue_d` | Date (month) | e.g. Apr-2011 | Month the loan was issued. |
| `annual_inc` | Continuous | USD | Self-reported annual income. |
| `dti` | Continuous | ratio, 0–35 | Debt-to-income: monthly non-mortgage debt payments ÷ monthly income. |
| `emp_length` | Ordinal | <1 to 10+ years | Employment length in years (`NA` when not provided). |
| `emp_title` | Categorical (text) | — | Borrower job title (free text, high-cardinality; `NA` ≈ 6%). |
| `home_ownership` | Categorical | RENT, OWN, MORTGAGE, OTHER, NONE | Home-ownership status. |
| `verification_status` | Categorical | Not Verified, Source Verified, Verified | Whether/how income was verified. |
| `addr_state` | Categorical | 49 U.S. states | Borrower state of residence. |
| `zip_code` | Categorical | 3-digit prefix (e.g. 007xx) | First three digits of the borrower ZIP code. |
| `fico_approx` | Derived (continuous) | FICO points, 662–847.5 | Midpoint of the origination FICO band (`(fico_range_low + fico_range_high)/2`). |
| `credit_history_age` | Derived (continuous) | years, 3.0–65.4 | Years between the earliest reported credit line and `issue_d`. |
| `open_acc` | Discrete | count, 1–49 | Number of open credit lines. |
| `total_acc` | Discrete | count, 2–99 | Total number of credit lines ever. |
| `revol_bal` | Continuous | USD | Total revolving credit balance. |
| `revol_util` | Continuous | %, 0–104 | Revolving-credit utilization rate (`NA` ≈ 0.1%). |
| `inq_last_6mths` | Discrete | count, 0–8 | Credit inquiries in the past 6 months. |
| `had_delinq` | Binary (derived) | 0/1 | 1 if the borrower has any delinquency on record (from `mths_since_last_delinq`). |
| `delinq_recent` | Binary (derived) | 0/1 | 1 if any 30+ days-past-due delinquency in the last 2 years (`delinq_2yrs > 0`). |
| `has_pub_rec` | Binary (derived) | 0/1 | 1 if the borrower has any derogatory public record (`pub_rec > 0`). |
| `total_pymnt` | Continuous | USD | Total payments received to date (includes `recoveries`). Payment record. |
| `total_rec_prncp` | Continuous | USD | Principal received to date. Payment record. |
| `total_rec_int` | Continuous | USD | Interest received to date. Payment record. |
| `total_rec_late_fee` | Continuous | USD | Late fees received to date. Payment record. |
| `recoveries` | Continuous | USD | Gross post-charge-off recovery. Payment record; defines `recovery_channel`. |
| `collection_recovery_fee` | Continuous | USD | Post-charge-off collection fee. Payment record; subtracted to form `payoff_net`. |
| `last_pymnt_d` | Date (month) | e.g. Aug-2013 | Month of the last payment received (`NA` ≈ 0.1%). |
| `id` | Identifier | — | Unique LendingClub loan ID. |
| `year` | Discrete | 2008–2012 | Loan issue year; also the subsetting filter. |
